asserted_claim: P=NP follows because D-coherence bounds the complexity of every problem space and makes search equivalent to verification.
missing_bridge: No formal complexity class, simulation, algorithm, runtime bound, or reduction maps D-coherence to deterministic polynomial-time search.
salvageable_seed: Treat the generator-checker gap as a measured fiber and record how much each proved invariant compresses it.
hard_test: Give a polynomial-time algorithm for one NP-complete language with a proved worst-case bound, or state a falsifiable lower-bound theorem outside known relativization/natural-proof/algebrization barriers.

asserted_claim: Global Navier-Stokes smoothness follows from D-coherence; musical fugues provide existence proofs.
missing_bridge: No map sends musical structure or the coherence axiom to a divergence-free velocity field satisfying the PDE, energy inequality, initial data, and scale-critical estimates.
salvageable_seed: Multiscale counterpoint suggests tracking interactions between frequency bands; the exact mathematical object is a nonlinear flux or commutator defect.
hard_test: Construct a scale-critical a priori estimate for smooth 3D solutions, or exhibit a typed transform from the proposed representation to a verified Navier-Stokes solution and prove preservation of the nonlinear term.

asserted_claim: The Yang-Mills mass gap follows from the eigenvalues of a Quantum Distinction Operator.
missing_bridge: No four-dimensional continuum Yang-Mills measure or Hilbert space satisfying the required axioms is constructed, and no gauge-invariant equivalence identifies the proposed operator with the physical Hamiltonian.
salvageable_seed: Quotient gauge or null modes before asking for coercivity; distinguish a coordinate gap from a physical spectral gap.
hard_test: Construct the theory with reflection positivity/locality and prove that the gauge-invariant Hamiltonian spectrum above the vacuum is bounded below uniformly in the continuum and infinite-volume limits.

asserted_claim: The Hodge and Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer conjectures follow from universal zero curvature R=0.
missing_bridge: No functor sends the proposed curvature to rational Hodge classes/algebraic cycles or to Selmer groups, Mordell-Weil rank, and the leading Taylor coefficient of an elliptic-curve L-function.
salvageable_seed: Separate analytic type from geometric witness, and treat zero order plus leading coefficient as fiber dimension plus metric data.
hard_test: For Hodge, construct an algebraic cycle with the claimed cohomology class; for BSD, construct the arithmetic comparison map and recover every regulator, period, Tamagawa, torsion, and Tate-Shafarevich factor.

asserted_claim: The functional equation is a perfect mirror, so every zeta resonance must lie on the mirror line and RH follows.
missing_bridge: An involutive symmetry sends a zero to a partner; it does not force every orbit to be a fixed point. Symmetric analytic functions can have off-axis paired zeros.
salvageable_seed: Decompose fixed and exchanged sectors, then seek a positivity or self-adjointness theorem that excludes nontrivial two-point orbits.
hard_test: State and prove the additional sign, positivity, or spectral hypothesis that turns reflection invariance into fixed-point support; test it on Davenport-Heilbronn-type functional equations with off-line zeros.

asserted_claim: RH is proved because it lives at a higher homotopy type/universe level where coherence becomes available.
missing_bridge: No formal statement equivalent to classical RH is derived from the higher-type construction; universe level changes syntax and available principles, not the truth of an unrelated arithmetic proposition.
salvageable_seed: Use higher types only when an explicit quotient, action groupoid, descent datum, or coherence obstruction survives 0-truncation.
hard_test: Formalize classical RH in the system, give a kernel-checked proof with audited axioms, and independently verify that the formal statement has the intended zeta-function semantics.
